title: AdaptaFlow
tagline: self-adjusting limit orders that automatically optimize slippage based on realtime market volatility
description:
AdaptaFlow is an AI-powered cross-chain trading protocol that intelligently optimizes slippage to protect users from losses during blockchain bridge delays and market volatility. It's essentially a "smart bridge" that adapts to real-time market conditions.

Traditional Cross-Chain Trading Issues:
Static Slippage: Users set fixed slippage (like 1%) but conditions change during bridge delays
Bridge Delays: Transfers between chains can take minutes/hours, exposing users to price movements
MEV Attacks: Bots exploit predictable cross-chain transactions
Poor UX: Users need to manually adjust slippage for different chain pairs

AdaptaFlow's Solution:
Dynamic Slippage: AI calculates optimal slippage in real-time based on multiple factors
Adaptive Protection: Slippage adjusts automatically as market conditions change
Cross-Chain Intelligence: Different optimization strategies for each blockchain pair
how_its_made:
Frontend: Next.js 15 with App Router for clean separation between landing page (/) and trading interface (/trade). Built with TypeScript for full type safety.
Wallet Integration: Dual wallet system using wagmi + RainbowKit for Ethereum and custom NEAR Wallet Selector integration. This allows simultaneous connection to both EVM and non-EVM chains.
AI Engine: Custom-built dynamic slippage calculator that processes real-time market data. Uses debounced API calls (1-second delay) to prevent excessive calculations during form input.
